name: Cinnamon Rolls
desc: Soft bread-machine rolls made with vanilla pudding, filled with brown sugar and cinnamon and spread with cream cheese frosting.

source.title: Bread Machine Cinnamon Rolls
source.evidence: Dough ingredients match the site's list in the same order (water, melted butter, vanilla pudding, milk, egg, sugar, salt, bread flour, yeast); pecans and frosting milk kept from the site version.

ingredients.raw: 1 (3.4 oz) package instant vanilla pudding mix
1 cup whole milk, warmed to about 110°F
4 cups bread flour, plus more for rolling
1 cup (2 sticks) unsalted butter, softened, plus more for the pan
ingredients.note: 2 sticks; plus more for the pan

steps: Dough: add the water, melted butter, pudding mix, warm milk, egg, sugar, salt, bread flour and yeast to the bread machine pan in that order. Run the Dough cycle (about 1 1/2 hours).
Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and roll it into a 17x10-inch rectangle.
Filling: beat the softened butter, brown sugar and cinnamon until smooth. Spread it evenly over the dough and sprinkle with the pecans.
Roll the dough up tightly, starting from a long side. Slice into 16 rolls about 1 inch thick.
Butter a 9x13-inch baking pan and arrange the rolls cut side up. Cover and let rise in a warm spot until doubled, about 45 minutes. Preheat the oven to 350°F while they rise.
Bake 15-20 minutes, until golden brown on top and the center rolls are cooked through.
Frosting: while the rolls bake, beat the cream cheese and butter until smooth, then beat in the powdered sugar, vanilla and salt. Add milk 1 tbsp at a time until spreadable.
Spread the frosting over the warm rolls and serve.
tips: The food.com original also brushes the rolls with melted butter and sprinkles them with extra brown sugar before the final rise, and bakes them in a jellyroll pan.

references.title: Cinnamon Rolls
references.usedFor: confirmed dough, filling and frosting amounts, 17x10 rectangle, 16 slices, 45 minute rise, 350°F bake, brush-with-butter variation
